translations.web: He slept and dreamed a second time; and behold, seven heads of grain came up on one stalk, healthy and good.
translations.bsb: but he fell back asleep and dreamed a second time: Seven heads of grain, plump and ripe, came up on one stalk.
translations.kjv: And he slept and dreamed the second time: and, behold, seven ears of corn came up upon one stalk, rank and good.
translations.asv: And he slept and dreamed a second time: and, behold, seven ears of grain came up upon one stalk, rank and good.
